replies.Do you ever get anxious when thinking ab: Yes, especially when problems feel abstract or complex. My neuroticism score is high, so I tend to overthink and worry about making mistakes. replies.Did you ever use AI to support your math: Yes, I used an AI tutor app to review basic algebra and calculus concepts. replies.Briefly, how do you perform a Principal: PCA reduces data dimensions by finding directions (principal components) that capture most variance. First, standardize the data. Then, compute the covariance matrix and find its eigenvalues and eigenvectors. Sort by eigenvalues, pick top k components, and project data onto them. The math is complex, but you don’t need to master it—just understand the goal: simplify data without losing key patterns.
